title: Zelensky warns Russia is preparing a major new attack
detail: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is preparing a major new attack on Ukraine. Reported via a single aggregated headline; scale, timing and target of the anticipated attack were not specified.

title: Kyiv says it has no intention of extending the war to Libya
detail: Ukraine's foreign minister said Kyiv has no intention of extending the war to Libya and that military action was never directed against Libya, per Le Monde's live coverage.
